issues.description: Method assembleBookstore: the problem statement and the template expect assembleBookstore to produce and return a Bookstore. In the solution Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift the function is declared as 'private static func assembleBookstore() -> [Book]' (line 31) but the function body returns 'Bookstore(books: books)' (line 57). This declared return type ([Book]) does not match the actual returned value (Bookstore) and conflicts with the call site in main that treats the result as a Bookstore (accessing .books). This mismatch will cause a compilation error and confuses students about the intended API.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the assembleBookstore signature and returned value consistent. Preferred fix: change the function signature in Sources/BookstoreLib/Client.swift to 'private static func assembleBookstore() -> Bookstore' so it returns the Bookstore instance constructed within the function and matches the usage in main. Alternatively, if the intent is to return [Book], update main to accept [Book] and adjust subsequent code, but returning Bookstore is the recommended correction to match the problem statement and template.
